gpu-keyhunt (tongriyaotxt) -- MIT.
Technique reference only for physics/crypto/secp256k1.mjs: windowed scalar
multiplication in Jacobian coordinates, Montgomery batch inversion, and the
key -> k*G -> HASH160 -> address pipeline. NO CODE WAS COPIED (that project is
Python/GPU; this is BigInt on the CPU) and the KEY SEARCH IS NOT PORTED.
